good_thing: (Colorado Springs, Colorado): Two rescued Alaska moose calves have arrived at Cheyenne Mountain Zoo’s Rocky Mountain Wild area. The seven-month-olds spent the summer together at the Alaska Zoo after their May rescue, and are now exploring a baby-proofed yard, eating well, and settling in together.
current_or_history: On November 21, 1783, Jean-François Pilâtre de Rozier and François Laurent, the Marquis d’Arlandes, made the first free flight with human passengers in a Montgolfier hot-air balloon.
tiny_fact: Sea otters have loose folds of skin beneath their forearms that work like pockets. They can tuck prey there while diving, keeping their paws free to continue foraging.
thought: You do not have to make every day remarkable for it to be worth having.
